title: Round-trip MongoDB CSV records with an empty leading field
summary: The MongoDB CSV preset reparsed the printer’s empty leading column. A later field retained its embedded comma and literal double quote through the public iterator.

change.description: The MongoDB CSV preset uses the same character for quoting and escaping. The lexer now recognizes a quote at the boundary of a quoted field before interpreting it as an escape.

notes: The printer must protect delimiters and quotes within a field. The caller’s original strings give an oracle independent of the lexer.
